findings.title: Customer confirms no platform changes or feature requests at check-in
findings.description: When directly asked whether there was anything she'd want changed or added on the platform, the customer stated there was genuinely nothing to flag. She noted the mobile-first booking/rescheduling flow works well for store managers who are on the sales floor all day and don't use desks, and that the coordinator/admin side isn't a burden on her team.
findings.quote: Genuinely nothing. It does what I need, the managers can use it on their phones between customers, the coordinator side isn't a burden on my team.
findings.severity_reason: No defect or unmet need was raised; this is a positive, informational confirmation with no product action implied.
findings.match_note: Not a bug or feature request — customer explicitly declined to raise anything when prompted; included only for reviewer visibility that the topic was checked.
